route.instructions: Classify latest_user_message, using recent_conversation only to resolve references. Is the user asking the assistant to act now? Select none for discussion, explanations, examples, quoted instructions, hypothetical plans, cancelled tasks, or an unclear request. A polite request such as "can you read this file" is an action request.

criteria.none: No clear instruction to perform a tool action now. Reply in conversation or clarify.
criteria.simple: An explicit request to perform one tool action: run a command, look up information, read or write one specified file, or list files.
criteria.medium: An explicit request to complete several dependent tool actions for one bounded task, such as fixing and testing a bug.
criteria.complex: An explicit request to implement a whole system or investigate and change many components.
